def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != background}
    marker = next(iter(markers))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        positions=[c for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v==marker]
        if len(positions)>=2:
            for c in range(min(positions)+1,max(positions)):
                if grid[r][c] != marker: out[r][c]=3
    for c in range(w):
        positions=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]==marker]
        if len(positions)>=2:
            for r in range(min(positions)+1,max(positions)):
                if grid[r][c] != marker: out[r][c]=3
    return out
